canada.title: ‘I can’t get to work’: Toronto residents speak out about shrinking accessible taxi fleet
canada.summary: Some Toronto residents with disabilities say they are facing growing challenges finding reliable, wheelchair-accessible transportation, raising concerns about their ability to get to work, attend appointments and keep up with everyday commitments.

canada.title: CFB Wainwright incident casts spotlight on reserve pay disparities: former bureaucrat
canada.summary: OTTAWA - A former director general for the Canadian military's reserves and cadets says the tragic incident at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright casts a spotlight on disparities in pay and benefits for reservists.

canada.title: New bridge in Prince George park is for frogs and other tiny critters
canada.summary: A new bridge above an amphibian migration trail in a Prince George city park is expected to give tiny salamanders, frogs and toads a fighting chance at survival each summer.

canada.title: Calgary's libraries, zoo could face budget cuts to bring proposed tax hike down
canada.summary: Calgary's investment in partner groups overseeing libraries, the zoo, tourism, arts and economic development, and more, is facing scrutiny after a city councillor suggested a 10-per-cent cut across the board to help the city lower a proposed property tax hike.

canada.title: Healing through horses: Sask. program builds confidence, connection and reconciliation
canada.summary: Mistatim Healing is giving students at Cut Knife Community School an opportunity to overcome anxiety. Teachers are already noticing positive changes.

canada.title: Wollaston Lake, Sask., celebrates final stage of all-season highway project
canada.summary: Wollaston Lake and Hatchet Lake Denesuline First Nation will have improved access to the south and to other northern communities. Planning and design work for Highway 995 began in 2004.

canada.title: Coyotes becoming more common neighbours in Steinbach
canada.summary: Some Steinbach residents are seeing more coyotes in city limits. One expert says that could be because the city is growing.

canada.title: This elementary teacher is carrying a school desk from Cambridge to Hamilton to raise money for cancer care
canada.summary: Cambridge elementary school teacher Adam Butter will carry a school desk from Hespeler in Cambridge to McMaster Children's Hospital in Hamilton, all to raise money for the hospital's pediatric oncology unit.

canada.title: Rise in costs cause disability non-profit to close its doors after 14 years
canada.summary: The John Wood Foundation is a charity that raises funds to support disabled New Brunswickers. It announced they will close for good after 14 years because of increasing operational costs.

canada.title: Remaining 3 N.S. health zones switch to One Person One Record today
canada.summary: One Person One Record launched at the IWK Health Centre last December and in the central health zone in May. Now the system goes live in the western, eastern and northern health zones.

canada.title: How a 2013 Halifax Mooseheads game fuels one of the team's current players
canada.summary: Growing up as the son of a Halifax Mooseheads executive, Quinn Kennedy spent a lot of time at games during his childhood, but one memory in particular stands out from when he was seven years old.

canada.title: New Iqaluit course teaches youth how to be content creators
canada.summary: In Iqaluit, there's a new content creator course teaching youth how to be influencers and streamers. The organizer says it’s the first step in a larger project, the launch of the Pinnguarvik “playroom” platform.

canada.title: These farmers are worried N.L. is facing another hay shortage
canada.summary: Farmers and livestock owners are once again at risk of running out of hay following a disastrous shortage last year, according to some farmers. Demand for hay is growing each year and production can’t keep up, says the owners of 3C Farms in Comfort Cove-Newstead.

canada.title: Minimum wage hasn't kept pace with the cost of living across Canada, new reports show
canada.summary: Of the 59 cities and regions in reports for every province reviewed by CBC News, none had a provincial minimum wage equal to the calculated living wage — the amount a full-time worker needs to meet their basic needs, manage unexpected expenses and participate meaningfully in their community.

canada.title: Montreal's deteriorating Dieppe Park to get $35M makeover — but not any time soon
canada.summary: Montreal is planning a $35-million makeover for Dieppe Park, including replacing its crumbling riverfront retaining wall. But surfers, fishermen and visitors will have to wait until 2029 for work to begin, and even that tentative date depends on further planning and environmental approvals.

canada.title: Quebec assumes parents help pay for post-secondary schooling. Students say many can't
canada.summary: Thousands of post-secondary and university students held strikes across Quebec this week to denounce “austerity measures and growing precariousness” among students in the face of the rising cost of living and the provincewide housing crisis. Among other things, the coalition is calling for a reform of Quebec's student financial aid program.
